name: _private.UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.FinitePMFProjection.0.UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.risk_bind_apply_toReal
type:
∀ {X : Type uX} {Z : Type uZ} [inst : Fintype X] (p : PMF X) (K : X → PMF Z) (z : Z),
  ((p.bind K) z).toReal = ∑ x, (p x).toReal * ((K x) z).toReal

name: PMF.bind_apply
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (p : PMF α) (f : α → PMF β) (b : β), (p.bind f) b = ∑' (a : α), p a * (f a) b

name: UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.ConditionedActionTransportCheck.occupied_conditioned_fibers_supply_actual_experiment
type:
∀ {X Y A : Type u} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype A] [inst_2 : Nonempty A] [inst_3 : MeasurableSpace X]
  [inst_4 : MeasurableSingletonClass X] [inst_5 : MeasurableSpace A] [inst_6 : MeasurableSingletonClass A]
  (M : UEOT.V3.FiniteDiscountedControl.Model X fun x => A) (q : X → Y) (basePolicy : Y → PMF A) (p0 : PMF X)
  (safe : Set X) (T : ℕ)
  (hpos :
    0 <
      UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.SameSourceFiniteWindowCheck.actualSurvivalMass M q basePolicy
        p0 safe T)
  (fallback : ℕ → ↑safe → PMF ↑safe) (outside : ℕ → X → PMF X),
  UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.ConditionedActionTransportCheck.OccupiedFiberFeasible M q
      (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.ConditionedActionTransportCheck.preparedInitial M q
        basePolicy p0 safe T hpos fallback outside)
      (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.ConditionedActionTransportCheck.conditionedTargetRow M q
        basePolicy safe T fallback outside)
      T →
    ∃ sigma,
      PMF.map (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.SourcePolicyPathBridgeCheck.eraseActionHistory T)
          (UEOT.V3.PathError.causalLaw
            (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.ConditionedActionTransportCheck.preparedInitial M q
              basePolicy p0 safe T hpos fallback outside)
            (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.riskMicroControlKernel q (fun x => M.transitionPMF)
              (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.ConditionedActionTransportCheck.timeObservationPolicy
                sigma))
            T) =
        UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.SameSourceFiniteWindowCheck.actualConditionedPrefix M q
          basePolicy p0 safe T 0 hpos

    ∃ sigma,

          (UEOT.V3.PathError.causalLaw p0
            (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.riskMicroControlKernel q (fun x => M.transitionPMF)
              (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.ConditionedActionTransportCheck.timeObservationPolicy

name: UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.ConditionedActionTransportCheck.state_selection_realizes_its_conditioned_path
type:
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Nonempty X] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace X]
  [inst_3 : MeasurableSingletonClass X] (basePolicy : X → PMF X) (p0 : PMF X) (safe : Set X) (T : ℕ)
  (hpos :
    0 <
      UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.SameSourceFiniteWindowCheck.actualSurvivalMass
        (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.ConditionedActionTransportCheck.stateSelectionModel X) id
        basePolicy p0 safe T)
  (fallback : ℕ → ↑safe → PMF ↑safe) (outside : ℕ → X → PMF X),
  ∃ sigma,
    PMF.map (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.SourcePolicyPathBridgeCheck.eraseActionHistory T)
        (UEOT.V3.PathError.causalLaw
          (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.ConditionedActionTransportCheck.preparedInitial
            (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.ConditionedActionTransportCheck.stateSelectionModel X)
            id basePolicy p0 safe T hpos fallback outside)
          (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.riskMicroControlKernel id
            (fun x =>
              (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.ConditionedActionTransportCheck.stateSelectionModel
                  X).transitionPMF)
            (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.ConditionedActionTransportCheck.timeObservationPolicy
              sigma))
          T) =
      UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.SameSourceFiniteWindowCheck.actualConditionedPrefix
        (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.ConditionedActionTransportCheck.stateSelectionModel X) id
        basePolicy p0 safe T 0 hpos

  (∀ (x : X),

  (∃ sigma,

        UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.FiniteActionRealizabilityCheck.actionMixture (P x)

type:

  (M : UEOT.V3.FiniteDiscountedControl.Model X fun x => A) (q : X → Y) (sigma : Y → PMF A) (p0 : PMF X) (n : ℕ),
  PMF.map (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.SourcePolicyPathBridgeCheck.eraseActionHistory n)
      (UEOT.V3.PathError.causalLaw p0
        (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.riskMicroControlKernel q (fun x => M.transitionPMF)
          (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.SourcePolicyPathBridgeCheck.observationMarkovPolicy
            sigma))
        n) =
    UEOT.V3.PathError.causalLaw p0
      (UEOT.V3.CoreOperationalAssembly.policyPathKernel M
        (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.SourcePolicyPathBridgeCheck.liftedStationaryPolicy q
          sigma))
      n

name: UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.TotalFiniteWindowCheck.generated_ambient_eq_actual
type:
∀ {X Y A : Type u} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype A] [inst_2 : Nonempty A] [inst_3 : MeasurableSpace X]
  [inst_4 : MeasurableSingletonClass X] [inst_5 : MeasurableSpace A] [inst_6 : MeasurableSingletonClass A]
  (M : UEOT.V3.FiniteDiscountedControl.Model X fun x => A) (q : X → Y) (sigma : Y → PMF A) (p0 : PMF X) (K : Set X)
  (t r : ℕ)
  (hpos :
    0 <
      UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.SameSourceFiniteWindowCheck.actualSurvivalMass M q sigma p0 K
        (t + r))
  (fallback : ℕ → ↑K → PMF ↑K) (outside : ℕ → X → PMF X),
  UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.TotalFiniteWindowCheck.generatedAmbientPrefix M q sigma p0 K
      (t + r) hpos fallback outside t =
    UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.SameSourceFiniteWindowCheck.actualConditionedPrefix M q sigma p0
      K t r hpos

name: UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.registered_unit_interventions_identify_factorization
type:

  [inst_3 : _root_.Module ℝ Y] (H H' : X →ₗ[ℝ] UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.TwoDriveLatent)

name: UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.FiniteMemoryPhysicalSafety.actual_state_prefix_eq

  (controller : UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.FiniteMemoryController M Y A) (p₀ : PMF X)

  (K : (n : ℕ) → UEOT.V3.PathError.CausalHistory X Z n → PMF Z) (f : X → Y) (g : Z → W)
  (L : (n : ℕ) → UEOT.V3.PathError.CausalHistory Y W n → PMF W) (n : ℕ),
  PMF.map (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.riskHistoryMap f g n)
